strings.name: Melanie Perkins
strings.role: Technology entrepreneur · Canva co-founder and CEO
strings.summary: While studying in Perth and teaching design software, Perkins saw an opportunity to simplify design. She founded Fusion Books with Cliff Obrecht, then built Canva with Obrecht and Cameron Adams, combining templates, collaboration and publishing. She led expansion into workplace and professional design and announced restructuring involving role changes, relocation and departures in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founding Canva broadened access to online visual design and lowered barriers to creating digital content for individuals and organizations.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Perth, Australia; her early ventures also began there.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Attended the University of Western Australia and taught design software while studying.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Making design easier
strings.highlights.h1.text: Her team combined templates, assets and online collaboration in a platform for broad audiences.
strings.highlights.h2.title: An equity pledge for social good
strings.highlights.h2.text: She and Obrecht pledged most of their personal equity to philanthropy; this was a commitment, not a completed donation of all those shares.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Announcing restructuring
strings.timeline.t1.text: She said changes would affect 1,271 people through changed roles, relocation and departures, acknowledging slower growth.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Canva AI 2.0 research preview
strings.timeline.t2.text: The company demonstrated conversational creation of editable designs, with wider access planned in stages.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Canva acquires Affinity
strings.timeline.t3.text: Professional photo, vector and page-layout software joined its business.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Expanding into a visual worksuite
strings.timeline.t4.text: Canva launched Visual Worksuite with documents, websites and whiteboards.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Pledging equity to philanthropy
strings.timeline.t5.text: She and Obrecht pledged personal equity representing about 30% of Canva's value to social good.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Launching Canva for Work
strings.timeline.t6.text: Professional features and subscriptions expanded workplace use.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Canva launches publicly
strings.timeline.t7.text: The online design platform developed with Obrecht and Adams became publicly available.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Co-founding Fusion Books
strings.timeline.t8.text: She and Obrecht built an online school-yearbook design business as a foundation for a broader platform.
